Problem Statement:
Given two arrays of the same size N, print 'yes' if they are mirror images of each other, otherwise print 'no'. 
Input Description:
First line: an integer N (1 ≤ N ≤ 1000000)
Second line: N space-separated integers (first array)
Third line: N space-separated integers (second array) 
Output Description:
Print 'yes' if the second array is the reverse of the first array
Otherwise, print 'no' 
Sample Input:
4
1 2 3 4
4 3 2 1 
Sample Output:
yes
